name: Uterga (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the arms of Uterga (a sheaf of wheat on red, timbred with a helmet) above the name UTERGA in yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Uterga; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
